source_findings.area: Scrape prior-save recognition and Save refusal copy
source_findings.finding: A failed saved-page lookup is now represented as unknown and the Scrape view says it could not check; it no longer implies the page has never been saved. Save refusals now extract the server's top-level user_message/message/remedy (with nested detail fallback) so the refusal sentence and remedy reach the person.
source_findings.inventory_action: Added EXT-F-1007-C27 and T26 for honest lookup-failure state. Existing C04/T21/T22 already cover landing refusal and the unsaved retry path; retained them and their IDs, no duplicate case added.

source_findings.finding: Saved Captures counts returned rows that fail client validation, keeps readable rows, displays a retryable unreadable-count notice, and does not show a false empty state when no readable row remains.
source_findings.inventory_action: Added EXT-F-2009-C37 and T06 because the partial-read/false-empty behavior was not covered by existing list, search, or detail cases.

source_findings.finding: Safari OAuth now uses an extension-owned background tab and dedicated Safari OAuth client; callbacks are bound to the active attempt, cancellation/timeout/failure are surfaced, and cleanup closes only an owned authorization or callback tab. The final commit permits the public Safari OAuth build input.
source_findings.inventory_action: Added EXT-F-1015-C15/C16/C17 and T36/T37 for real Safari sign-in, owned-tab cancellation/replacement, callback failure, timeout, and retry.

source_findings.finding: Only source comments were corrected: profile PII is saved for the person's own reference and no form-fill handler currently reads it.
source_findings.inventory_action: No inventory change; this is not a user-visible control or runtime behavior change.

source_findings.finding: Installed package changelogs were inspected: content-ir 0.18.6 and records 0.58.19 are automatic changed-only republishes with no consumer action. design-system 0.42.1 adds ErrorActions on package errors; its explicit consumer action is to mount ErrorActionsProvider once at the app root if the host wants these actions. The extension uses the design-system package but no ErrorActionsProvider currently appears in src/entrypoints/sidepanel/App.tsx.
source_findings.inventory_action: No feature inventory delta. Actionable package follow-up: decide whether the extension should provide host error actions; if yes, mount ErrorActionsProvider once at the sidepanel root and supply extension-appropriate retry/remedy rendering. This is optional per the changelog and not a package-required code migration; content-ir and records require no adoption.

prior_evidence_impact.retained_history: The existing guest-local-001 history remains attached to its original case/cell; T04 already records unverified-after-source-change and says old Save evidence is not fresh proof. New T26 is unverified-after-source-change. No prior pass was upgraded.
Existing T02/T03/T04/T05 IDs and their results remain unchanged. T06 is unverified-after-source-change; no prior list pass was recorded as evidence for malformed-row handling.

Safari has no prior UI result, so T36/T37 start unverified-after-source-change. EXT-F-1003-T52 already preserves admin-signin-001 as historical pass while current result is unverified after earlier auth transport changes; this reconciliation keeps that history and does not treat it as Safari proof.

next_tests: Exercise Safari sign-in through the actual extension and a real OAuth flow, including cancel, stale/invalid callback, replacement attempt, timeout, retry, and owned-tab cleanup; record Safari-specific runtime identity and auth state.

Exercise Scrape lookup failure with controlled capture data and verify the unknown state does not claim the page is new; exercise representative server refusal envelopes and confirm their user message/remedy is visible.
Exercise Saved Captures with one intentionally unreadable returned row plus readable rows, then retry after correcting the row; verify the notice and non-empty truthfulness.
limitations: Source-only reconciliation; no builds, tests, browser sessions, or runtime outcomes were performed.
Chat and Pilot remain deferred under the campaign plan.
Safari OAuth depends on real configured client/callback registration and cannot be verified by source inspection alone.
Package changelogs were read from the installed package graph after the coordinator's frozen-lock install; no package or application source edits were made in this lane.
